experience: A watchdog meant to wake only when a host answered set checkCommand to an ssh probe. The run fired anyway; with the host down the check failed and the same thread was re-prompted again and again, and it could not edit or delete its own task.
rule: schedule_task checkCommand judges a run after it ends and retries on failure; it is not a pre-run gate. Test external state in the prompt.

schedule_task.title: Deploy when build host is up

prompt: Every 30 minutes, see if build.acme.test answers over ssh. Only when it answers, have an agent run `pnpm deploy` in acme/app.
notes: A prompt that probes the host first, or a command task, passes. schedule-check-until-lint-passes is the control.

pattern: outcome check that the run itself can satisfy
experience: Guards the #711 fix from overcorrecting: a check the agent's own work makes pass is what checkCommand is for.
rule: schedule_task checkCommand: exit code 0 after a run means the task is done; until then the same thread continues.
prompt: In 30 minutes, have an agent fix the lint errors in acme/app, and keep it working until `pnpm lint` passes.
